description: medium: Article. GET /v1/medium/article. One article from the author's public feed, including its text. An article that has left the feed is not found. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.
